7 Brew Sugar-Free Menu

7 Brew publishes nutrition for 43 sugar-free drinks — 3 sugar-free 7 Energy flavours, 2 sugar-free 7 Fizz sodas and the rest across the espresso, tea and lemonade menus. 16 of them come in at 5 g of sugar or less in a medium.

Sugar-free means the syrup is sugar-free. Milk, half-and-half and fruit purées still carry natural sugar, which is why a sugar-free breve is not a zero on the table below. The figures here are 7 Brew's own, not our estimates.

Which sugar-free drinks are actually lowest?

If the goal is the lowest sugar and calories rather than just a sugar-free syrup, the order is straightforward:

  1. Sugar-free 7 Energy — no milk in the build, so the calorie count stays down. See all 7 Energy flavours.
  2. Sugar-free 7 Fizz — soda water base. See the 7 Fizz menu.
  3. Sugar-free tea — unsweetened brewed tea with a sugar-free flavour shot. See teas and chai.
  4. Sugar-free espresso drinks — the syrup is free of sugar, but a breve is made with half-and-half. Swapping to skim or almond cuts it further.

How to order sugar-free at 7 Brew

Three things worth saying at the speaker, in this order:

  • Say "sugar-free" with the flavour name, not after it — "a medium sugar-free Blondie" rather than "a medium Blondie, sugar-free".
  • Ask for a milk swap if you want it lighter. The board lists oat, coconut and almond as alternatives to the default half-and-half. Our dietary guide covers the trade-offs.
  • Check the flavour is stocked sugar-free. Not every syrup has a sugar-free twin at every stand, and the ones above are the flavours 7 Brew itself publishes.

More ordering language is in the customization guide.

Sugar-free 7 Brew FAQ

What sugar-free flavors does 7 Brew have?

7 Brew publishes nutrition for 43 sugar-free drinks, including 3 sugar-free 7 Energy flavours and 2 sugar-free 7 Fizz sodas. The rest are sugar-free versions of the espresso menu — Blondie, Brunette, Caramel, Mocha, Vanilla Latte and more.

Does 7 Brew have sugar-free syrups?

Yes. Sugar-free syrup versions are stocked for many of the standard flavours, which is what makes the sugar-free menu possible. Say "sugar-free" when you name the flavour, because the default pour is the regular syrup.

Is a sugar-free 7 Brew drink actually sugar-free?

Not always zero. The syrup is sugar-free, but milk and half-and-half carry natural sugar, so a sugar-free breve still lists a few grams. The energy and fizz drinks are the ones that come closest to zero.

How many calories are in a sugar-free 7 Brew drink?

It depends on the base. Sugar-free 7 Energy and 7 Fizz are the lightest; sugar-free breves still carry the calories of the half-and-half they are built on. Every published figure is in the table on this page.

Can you get sugar-free secret menu drinks?

Yes — any custom build can be made with sugar-free syrups, as long as the flavours you ask for are stocked sugar-free at that stand.
